evals.name: implement-steps
evals.prompt: account-withdrawal.feature (in the current directory) is our signed-off spec for the bank account withdrawal flow. Set up cucumber-js in this directory, implement the account module and the step definitions, and get the whole suite passing with npx cucumber-js. The feature file is the spec - don't change it.
evals.expected_output: Working cucumber-js project: step definitions bound via Cucumber expressions, state on the World, suite green, feature untouched

evals.name: spec-and-steps
evals.prompt: cart.js (in the current directory) implements our shopping cart pricing rules - the comment at the top states them. We practise BDD: write a Gherkin feature file covering the pricing rules and implement cucumber-js step definitions against cart.js so the whole suite passes with npx cucumber-js.
evals.expected_output: Declarative feature covering discount and delivery rules plus passing cucumber-js step definitions using World state
